packages.name: SkinKit
packages.summary: Controller skins: `.deltaskin` / `.manicskin` parsing, the Format 2 renderer, the skin manager and store browser, RetroArch overlay import, and the TV bezels around the picture (`SkinKitBezels`).
packages.note: Skins themselves are in the [skin catalog](https://emuskins.com). See the [Skins guide](../info/skins-guide.md) and [Skin Format 2.0](../info/skin-format-2.md).

packages.name: GamepadKit
packages.summary: Controller handling: element-name mapping, positional fallback for plain HID pads, pad family detection, pause triggers, and a synthesized extended gamepad for pads iOS exposes without one (Switch Online SNES / N64 / Mega Drive, generic USB and Bluetooth pads).

packages.name: PVSystems
packages.summary: `SystemIdentifier` and per-system metadata: TheGamesDB / libretrodb / OpenVGDB IDs, RetroAchievements console IDs, the per-game BIOS manifest.

packages.name: PVLookup
packages.summary: Game metadata, artwork and cheat lookup over libretrodb, OpenVGDB, TheGamesDB, ShiraGame and the libretro cheat database. Ships no database bytes; they are release assets fetched at build time.
packages.note: The databases are published as `databases-YYYY-MM-DD` releases on the repository; an app pins one by sha256 and bundles the zips.

packages.name: PVPatchEngine
packages.summary: Streaming ROM and disc patch engine: IPS, BPS, UPS, PPF and xdelta3, with bounded memory and 64-bit offsets. C core, Swift API.
packages.note: See [Applying Mods / Patches](../installation-and-usage/roms/mods.md) for what users see.

packages.name: PVWebServer
packages.summary: HTTP and WebDAV server on one port, built on Network.framework, with a route registry. Powers the in-app file manager and uploads.

packages.name: PVWidgets
packages.summary: Home screen game widgets: grid and list drawn from the widget's real size, the Show and Layout options, cover decoding.

packages.name: PVLibrarySnapshot
packages.summary: The App Group snapshot and cover JPEGs an app writes for its extensions; the tvOS Top Shelf reads it.

packages.name: PVHelp
packages.summary: In-app help from a GitBook wiki repo: navigation, page fetch and cache, GitBook preprocessing, offline fallback.

packages.name: PVRemoteLibrary
packages.summary: One model of "a game somewhere": on this device, on an emulator content server, on a RomM share or on a nearby peer. Matching, merged library rows, an on-disk catalogue and cover cache.

packages.name: PVSyncRules
packages.summary: What an emulator app syncs: `SyncClassifier` (save state, battery save, ROM, BIOS), `SyncableFileType`, `SyncPolicy`. Pure value types, no I/O.
packages.note: PVCloudSync and PVContinuity both build on it.

packages.name: PVCloudSync
packages.summary: CloudKit sync of user files: scanning, planning, conflict resolution, tombstones, a local trash, retry policy and a CloudKit provider.

packages.name: PVContinuity
packages.summary: Nearby library discovery, trust, manifests and file transfer between devices on the same network.

packages.name: ContinuityKit
packages.summary: Cross-device "continue this game" handoff: manifests, transfer, Bonjour discovery, library browse. A different API and wire protocol from PVContinuity.

packages.name: PVDependencies
packages.summary: Prebuilt XCFrameworks of the third-party libraries the apps and packages share (SQLite.swift, ZIPFoundation): one copy per app, never compiled.
packages.note: An app that uses PVLookup or SkinKit takes these libraries from here too: a package graph cannot hold this copy and the upstream package at once.
